method: Both modes retain early next-wave reads and an eight-ready threshold. At the start of a four-row verification layer with no resident group, B submits the following known demand wave before waiting for the initial group; A submits it only after the first GPU submission. At most two admitted waves, same ordered consumer, reader pool and ownership. Five new sequential fresh-server pairs (AB, BA, AB, BA, AB); identical warmup, then one uncached 912-ID handover, fixed 8 GiB, depth three, 64 greedy output IDs. Clean TPS counts 63 first-to-last stream intervals. Medians exclude the separate profiled B/A runs with 24 real verification rounds. File cache and thermals uncontrolled.
